name: io.github.atelierfactory/agent-pr-ledger
description: Counts agent-authored pull requests merged with and without a human review record (definition v1.0). It counts; it does not score. Read-only.

environment_variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: GitHub token (read-only use). Optional; raises the API limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour.
